set.body:
Outcome

Provide one discoverable public entry without introducing a second ontology.

Acceptance

- Predictive and relational estimands use the same source, frame, plan, result, and receipt vocabulary.
- The shortest raw-source-to-result paths compile in JVM and Scala.js examples.
- Error messages name the mismatched axis, role, stage, or capability.
- A downstream test estimand proves public extensibility without internal access.
set.title: P2.6: expose one ergonomic Mvpa facade over the compiler
